remarks: Prime Commercial Investment Opportunity in Norwalk, Connecticut Turnkey Restaurant with High Foot Traffic area. This prime commercial property in SONO brings a fantastic investment opportunity and a strategic location. The space is fully equipped with kitchen appliances that are 7 years old, providing a turnkey solution for a foodservice or restaurant operation. Situated in a high-traffic area, the property enjoys excellent visibility and foot traffic, making it an ideal spot for retail, dining, or service-oriented businesses. Located just minutes from Norwalk's waterfront and with easy access to I-95, this property benefits from strong local demand and convenient transportation links. In addition, there is ample street parking as well as a rear municipal parking lot, offering convenience for customers and employees alike. This property presents an outstanding opportunity for investors looking to acquire a fully operational commercial space in one of Connecticut's most vibrant and growing markets.
